When processing collections of assets or inputs, normalize the input using an array helper (e.g., `asArray`) and filter out non-record entries before mapping or flat-mapping over them to prevent TypeErrors on null, undefined, or non-array inputs.

```javascript
function pageIndexesFromLocatedPages(locatedPages) {
  return asArray(locatedPages)
    .filter(isRecord)
    .map((page) => page.pdf_page_index_zero_based)
    .filter((pageIndex) => Number.isInteger(pageIndex));
}
```

When destructuring function parameters, destructure from `params || {}` rather than relying solely on parameter defaults like `function foo({ bar } = {})` if the function can be called with an explicit `null`. This prevents a destructuring `TypeError` and allows the `null` input to reach internal validation logic.

```javascript
function groupRows(inputs) {
  const { pageLocatorInventory, runtimeSourceMap } = inputs || {};
```

When indexing assets or records into a map/object by an ID, normalize the input collection using an array helper (e.g., `asArray`), filter out non-record entries, and ensure only entries with a non-empty ID string are indexed to prevent malformed or empty keys.

```javascript
  const outputById = new Map(asArray(locator?.rows)
    .filter((row) => isRecord(row) && isNonEmptyString(row.question_row_id))
    .map((row) => [row.question_row_id, row]));
```
